verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and a Subscriptions API, so an agent can query billing objects directly. However, the evidence never shows the MCP server or API exposing the specific billing-state answers the story names. Subscription analytics such as performance monitoring are documented only as a Dashboard view, not as something an agent can query. missing for 10: documented agent-queryable MRR metric, delinquent-account querying via MCP/API, upcoming-renewal listing, per-customer invoice lookup through the MCP server, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
Create a new subscription in the Dashboard or with the Subscriptions API.
